blocks.label: Hero
blocks.description: The page's first screen: a short heading, one sentence, one action and one picture — or, on the home page, the live site with Galley's proof laid over it.

blocks.label: Film
blocks.description: A captioned video with chapters that loads only when played, beside a heading and one line.

blocks.label: Tabbed captures
blocks.description: Two to four jobs as tabs beside one capture panel; choosing a tab swaps the capture.

blocks.label: Proof sheet
blocks.description: An example proof set in real text, each change struck out and written in with a working Put back, and margin notes on the marks.

blocks.label: Dark band
blocks.description: One idea on the dark ground beside what a terminal shows; once a page.

blocks.label: Starters
blocks.description: The starters with large real pictures and look buttons, read from each starter's own files, with an optional page-builder line.

blocks.label: Text and capture
blocks.description: One idea, with optional points and a link, beside the capture that shows it.

blocks.label: What's in the release
blocks.description: Features grouped by status, rendered from src/data/status.json, the only place the site states a status.

blocks.label: Linked cards
blocks.description: Two or three cards, each a title and one line, linking on.

blocks.label: Closing card
blocks.description: A heading, one line and the actions on the dark ground, optionally with the real commands to run.

blocks.label: Marked lists
blocks.description: Up to four short lists side by side, each headed by a proof mark: what comes, what changes, what stays behind.

blocks.label: Comparison table
blocks.description: A fair two-column comparison in short cells, saying where the other tool does more, with a note under it.

blocks.label: Steps
blocks.description: Three numbered steps, each with one line, a status badge if needed and a capture of its result.

blocks.label: Questions
blocks.description: Three to six questions with their answers open; a calm section near the end.

blocks.label: Team
blocks.description: People with their photograph, name, title and one line: one featured first, the rest as equals; the alt text is the person's name.

templates.label: Landing page
templates.description: A product or feature page: hero, a text-and-capture section, a marked list, questions and a closing card.

templates.label: Comparison page
templates.description: For people moving from another tool: hero, what moves and what stays, a fair comparison table, three steps and an honest close.

templates.label: Coming soon
templates.description: Something announced but not ready: hero with an email link, who it is for and what is planned, and the promise.
